name: @builderforce/voice-provenance
description: Provenance for synthesized voice clips, declared once: the signed manifest contract and its canonical serialisation, the inaudible spread-spectrum audio watermark (embed + detect) and the PCM16/WAV helpers both synthesis paths share, so the api (server synthesis, signing, verify), the on-device engine's host and the web client all agree on exactly what is signed and what is embedded. Dependency-free and source-only: every consumer aliases the bare specifier straight at src/index.ts.
